params.message:
Footer: navigation and services side by side, five columns on wide screens

The second footer column stacked Navigatie above Diensten, a long single
column next to three short ones. Each group now has its own column:

- xl: brand, navigation, services, contact, hours in one row; the lists
  take their natural width so no title wraps in any of the five locales
  (the longest is "Reparaciones y mantenimiento").
- lg: brand on the left, the four groups in two rows beside it (five
  columns do not fit at 1024).
- Tablet: brand across, then navigation | services and contact | hours.
- Phone: navigation and services as two short lists side by side, with
  tighter line height so a wrapped service title reads as one item.

The hours row gets a gap so day and time cannot touch when the column is
at its natural width.
